outputs.explanation: Panel A shows spatial deconvolution heatmap overlays on tissue images, not a summary plot requiring individual data point overlays.
Panel B is a box plot (exempt type showing distribution) and additionally displays individual data points as dots scattered over the boxes.
Panel C shows GSEA enrichment line plots, a plot type exempt from requiring individual data point overlays.

Panel D is a bar chart of log2 fold-change values per gene derived from a single differential expression comparison (not a mean of replicate measurements with variability), so individual data points are not applicable.
Panel E consists of H&E and IHC micrographs/photographs, not a plot of averaged data.
